synthesis.method: deterministic clustering of frozen E1 evidence by (tables, GROUP BY, aggregates, ORDER/LIMIT) with hand-audited family abstractions; zero model calls

guards.G-EXACT-OUTPUT: project exactly the asked-for columns; no boolean helper columns
guards.G-NO-ROUND: never add ROUND/CAST-to-rounded unless the template itself has it
guards.G-DISTINCT-LIST: listing questions ('what kind of', 'list') require DISTINCT over the join result
guards.G-SCOPE-DENOM: percentage/ratio denominators must equal the question scope (conditional SUM form when scope is a condition)
guards.G-SEMANTIC-BINDING: bind business terms to the recorded column semantics ('total price of a transaction' = Price)
guards.G-TIME-BOUNDARY: morning = Time < '13:00:00' (recorded reference boundary, negative-q36 counterexample: 12:00:00 failed); exact times as equality on the stored strings
guards.G-GROUP-KEY: GROUP BY the projected entity only; no extra grouping columns
guards.G-NULL-EMPTY: aggregates over empty/all-NULL sets yield NULL/0 per SQL semantics; empty results stay empty

descriptors.purpose: Count rows of one dimension table matching one or two exact attribute filters
descriptors.applicable_when: question asks 'how many <entity>' with attribute equalities on a single table (gasstations/customers/products); no aggregation over facts, no time range

descriptors.purpose: Customer (or segment) with the most/least total Consumption, optionally filtered by segment, currency, year or exact month
descriptors.applicable_when: question asks who/which customer consumed the most or least gas, or asks for the consumption total too; customers joined to yearmonth

params.name: period
params.bind_from: a year ('in 2012') -> SUBSTR(Date,1,4)='YYYY'; a month ('June 2012') -> Date='YYYYMM'

descriptors.sql_template: SELECT {selector}[ , SUM(T2.Consumption)] FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE {filters} GROUP BY {selector} ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) {dir} LIMIT 1

output_contract.rounding: none — never wrap SUM in ROUND
output_contract.tie: LIMIT 1 keeps exactly one row; do not add tie-break columns not requested

descriptors.purpose: Segment (grouping column) whose aggregated Consumption is smallest/largest
descriptors.applicable_when: question asks 'which <grouping attribute>' had the least/most total consumption, no per-customer output
descriptors.sql_template: SELECT T1.Segment FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID GROUP BY T1.Segment ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) {dir} LIMIT 1

output_contract.rounding: none — the reference emits the raw SUM ordering; adding ROUND to the output changes nothing here but ROUND in ORDER BY over equal-displayed values is forbidden

descriptors.purpose: Month with highest total Consumption for a customer segment within a year
descriptors.applicable_when: question asks for the consumption peak month / busiest month for a segment in a year

params.name: bucket_expr
params.note: month digits of the YYYYMM string

descriptors.sql_template: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '{year}' AND T1.Segment = '{segment}' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

descriptors.family: conditional aggregation in one row (diff / ratio / percentage)
descriptors.purpose: Compare two subgroups of one table with SUM(IF(...)) arithmetic: difference, ratio, or percentage, without GROUP BY
descriptors.applicable_when: question compares two attribute values ('more X than Y, how many more', 'ratio of X to Y', 'what percentage of <scope> is <subset>') or computes a within-scope percentage

params.name: scope
params.bind_from: scope filter of the percentage denominator (must equal the question scope, expressed as a conditional SUM when the scope is itself a condition)

structure.where: none for scope-conditional forms; the WHERE-less form divides by SUM(IF(scope,1,0))
structure.aggregation: SUM(IF(cond,...)) arithmetic; CAST(... AS FLOAT) before division

forms.ratio: SELECT CAST(SUM(IF({cond_a},1,0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IF({cond_b},1,0)) FROM {table}
forms.pct_of_count: SELECT CAST(SUM({cond_a}) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT({pk}) FROM {table} WHERE {scope}
forms.pct_of_scope_sum: SELECT CAST(SUM(IF({scope} AND {cond_a},1,0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IF({scope},1,0)) FROM {table}
forms.ym_diff: SELECT SUM(IF({ya},{val},0)) - SUM(IF({yb},{val},0)) FROM yearmonth WHERE {row_scope}
forms.ym_rate: SELECT CAST(SUM(IF({ya},{val},0)) - SUM(IF({yb},{val},0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IF({yb},{val},0)) FROM yearmonth WHERE {row_scope}

descriptors.sql_template: see structure.forms — bind exactly one form

output_contract.rounding: none — never add ROUND(...,2); division uses CAST AS FLOAT, exact value
output_contract.boolean_helper_columns: forbidden — 'is it true that X, how many more' wants the single difference value only
output_contract.null: SUM over empty table is NULL; ratio with zero denominator is NULL

descriptors.note: reference-q1 does not exist (q1 is validation half); the ratio form is the same shape as reference-q42's CAST/SUM pattern

descriptors.family: distinct value list through transaction joins
descriptors.purpose: List the distinct values of one attribute reachable from transactions_1k through equality joins (chain of a station used in EUR transactions, product descriptions sold in CZE, currency paid at a moment)
descriptors.applicable_when: question says 'list'/'what kind of'/'which chains/descriptions/currencies' reachable from transactions

params.name: target
params.bind_from: the listed noun; target table = gasstations/products/customers

params.name: filters
params.bind_from: country/currency/date/time equality predicates from the question

descriptors.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT {target_expr} FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN {mid} ... WHERE {filters}

output_contract.rows: as many distinct values as exist (>=1 in this dataset)
output_contract.distinct: DISTINCT is mandatory — without it duplicate join rows appear
output_contract.empty: no matching transactions -> empty result (0 rows), do not fabricate

descriptors.purpose: COUNT / AVG over transactions_1k rows filtered by joins (station country) and/or date/time predicates
descriptors.applicable_when: question asks how many transactions / average price over a filtered transaction set; 'morning' means Time < '13:00:00' (recorded reference boundary, verified by negative-q36)

params.name: filters
params.bind_from: country (join), Price condition, Date='YYYY-MM-DD', Time < '13:00:00' for morning

joins: only tables needed for the filter (gasstations for Country, customers for Currency)

descriptors.sql_template: SELECT {agg} FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN {filter_table} ... WHERE {filters}

output_contract.semantic_binding: 'average total price of transactions' = AVG(Price) per transaction; do NOT multiply Amount*Price unless the question defines total = Amount*Price
output_contract.null: AVG over zero matching rows is NULL

descriptors.family: point lookup / per-entity extremum on transactions
descriptors.purpose: Fetch an attribute for an exact transaction moment (Date+Time), or an exact yearmonth value, or the top spender of one date
descriptors.applicable_when: question pins an exact timestamp ('at HH:MM:SS in YYYY/M/D'), an exact Consumption value in a month, or asks who paid the most on one date

params.name: point
params.bind_from: Date='YYYY-MM-DD' AND Time='HH:MM:SS' | Date='YYYYMM' AND Consumption=<v>

joins: only tables on the path to the target
structure.order_limit: top-of-date: ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC LIMIT 1

descriptors.sql_template: mode-dependent; top-of-date: SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date='{d}' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC LIMIT 1

output_contract.rows: 1 for point lookups in this dataset
output_contract.distinct: DISTINCT on point lookups is allowed and keeps identical rows from collapsing
